title: fisk-ai A2A v1 elicit reply
description: One answer to an elicit request, addressed to the task that asked. Nothing authenticates it beyond the transport's own permissions: whoever may address a running task may answer its questions, and one of those answers approves a confirmation-gated command.

question_id.description: The question this answers. A reply naming a question the task did not ask is dropped.

answer.description: Which field below carries the answer, so an empty value and a zero index are never confused with an absent one. no_operator says the caller has nobody to ask, which is an answer rather than a failure and which fails closed. waiting carries no field and answers nothing: it says the question is in front of a person and nobody has answered yet, which restarts the wait_ms window the question is held open for. Send one every third of that window while the question is displayed, stop before sending the answer, and send no_operator rather than falling silent when the person has gone.

choice.description: Answers an approve question. once authorizes the one call that asked; always covers that tool for the rest of the conversation.

index.description: Answers a select question, as a position in the options that were sent. An index outside them is treated as no choice.

value.description: Answers an input question. An empty string is a valid answer. Bounded because it is third-party input that reaches a model and a terminal.
